permanentRules: Four physical slots, distinct from stacked copies

phases.name: Authenticate fresh first-party market source
needs: Stage111 original collector, Stage110/104/69 raw provenance
deliverables: Raw HTTPS archive hashes and first-party publication receipt
Explicit quarantine if any source is stale/incomplete
acceptance: Original pinned source chain executed or independently verified with actual original code
All three canonical page URL/status/body digests and publisher metadata agree
No publication time inferred from crawl date; no authority flags enabled

phases.name: Verify item mapping, stacks and candidate semantics
deliverables: Verified crosswalk coverage and explicit unknown mappings
Isolated four-physical-slot versus four-total-copy planner regression plan
acceptance: Unknown variants or quantities do not receive current prices
Stack-copy planner limitation addressed in a separate reviewed source/test change when authorized

phases.name: Improve growth and bilateral attractiveness offline
needs: Independent demand, actual exit-liquidity evidence or UNKNOWN labels
deliverables: Deterministic upgrade, downgrade, sidegrade and target-purchasing-power scorecard
Separate our-benefit and their-appeal estimates with confidence
Compare no-loss alternatives before 0–3% hypothetical quality losses
acceptance: Never turn synthetic demand scores into measured acceptance odds
Regression on offer revisions, source expiry and change invalidation

phases.name: Build private verified-outcome learning dataset
needs: Independent settlement corroboration and exact session/item association
deliverables: Redacted private schema for proposals and outcomes
acceptance: 17 historical webhook claims and 30 test records never become success labels
UNKNOWN/CANCELED/DECLINED are distinct; no fabricated completed trade
Any future model change evaluated on unseen time windows before deployment

phases.name: Integrate observational shadow decisions
needs: Existing verified P3/P4 observer and tested snapshot contracts
deliverables: No physical action runtime and interruption recovery matrix
acceptance: No live offer/Accept/Decline/teleport during shadow runs
Changed offer or stale source yields REPLAN_REQUIRED/BLOCKED
No re-running closed Stage119 device experiments without a distinct new question

phases.name: Consider unattended operation only after verified gates
needs: Proven independent settlement and state freshness
Separately approved tested risk budget and deployment
deliverables: Exact CI, user-device and live-safety acceptance evidence
Emergency stop and fail-closed behavior; no duplicate side effects
acceptance: Gingerscope never outbound; automatic Accept cannot activate with UNKNOWN state
No listing or client-only observation used to assert profit or completed transaction
Explicit separate approval before final Accept or value-loss policy deployment
